blurb: Guests do a tandem skydive from about 12,000 to 13,000 feet with a certified instructor. The experience includes a safety briefing, gearing up, a scenic flight, freefall for 40-60 seconds, and a parachute ride over the Sonoran Desert. The center operates near Phoenix and Scottsdale, Arizona, with state-of-the-art equipment and top safety standards.

quotes.author: Ashlyn Tillman
quotes.text: Truly can say this was one of the best things I have ever done. The pilot, instructors, and other staff made this entire experience fun, safe, and so enjoyable. I already can’t wait to do it again. Thank you guys for an unforgettable morning!!!

quotes.author: Rob Miniuk
quotes.text: I've tandem jumped about 15 times. First time at PSC. It was my best experience!! The team was amazing! Great folks and highly recommend! I'm going back soon!!!
